_comment: Single source of truth for product LaunchAgents installed by install.sh. Drift between manifest, templates, and install.sh is gated by scripts/check-installer-parity.js in pre-commit. Owner-personal legacy plists are not declared here — product backup uses com.robotdojo.backup.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.server
agents.description: Main Hono server on HTTPS port 4338 — serves UI and /api/*.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.keychain-bridge
agents.description: Aqua Keychain bridge — decrypts robotdojo-LOCAL_DB_KEY for hardened coding-agent hosts that cannot call security -w.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.tunnel
agents.description: Standalone relay tunnel — keeps remote Connect reachability independent from server restarts.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.cloudflared
agents.description: Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared) — per-user named tunnel keeping remote Connect reachable at {slug}.connect.robotdojo.ai, independent from server restarts.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.keepawake
agents.description: Relay keep-awake assertion — prevents idle, disk, and AC-power system sleep so public links stay reachable.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.cohort-poll
agents.description: Hourly cohort-key revocation poller — restarts server in WB mode on revocation.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.sync
agents.description: Incremental Gmail/Calendar/Drive sync every 5 minutes.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.chunk-worker
agents.description: Background chunk-source scanner — chunks new emails/calendar/transcripts every 2 minutes. Embedding is owned by the chunk-embed-daemon.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.chunk-embed-daemon
agents.description: Long-lived embedder — drains the embedding backlog value-first, pauses on server activity, never idle. KeepAlive.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.integration-monitor
agents.description: OAuth token health monitor — checks Google/Oura/Notion every 15 minutes.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.integration-resync
agents.description: Periodic full Google resync — drains history for every connected account every 4 hours, yielding to chat.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.login-probe
agents.description: Apex login health probe — verifies cookie-session round-trip every minute and restarts only the relay tunnel on remote-only failure.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.relay-watchdog
agents.description: Relay SNI watchdog — verifies the public device subdomain every minute and alerts on a sustained outage. systemd owns relay restart since st_63b59bda; this probes and notifies, it does not repair.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.cert-renew
agents.description: Daily device TLS cert renewal via the relay; self-heals per-device registration.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.disk-watchdog
agents.description: Disk watchdog — bounds Robot Dojo launchd logs every 5 minutes so disk pressure cannot take down relay-critical local services.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.backup
agents.description: Daily product-state backup dispatcher — noops when skipped or unconfigured.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.topic-edit-watcher
agents.description: Detects topic taxonomy edits and triggers reclassification every 60 seconds.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.ramwatch
agents.description: Per-slot RAM watchdog — terminates runaway processes every 60 seconds.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.structure-check
agents.description: Daily filesystem structure audit — runs at 03:17 local time.

agents.label: com.robotdojo.spend-watchdog
agents.description: API spend watchdog — reads the spend ledgers every 15 minutes and notifies when a ceiling band worsens, so a runaway is caught while there is a day left to act rather than at the invoice.
